definition: a worker who fixes pipes and sinks
description: A man in a blue polo kneels with his toolbox in a bathroom while the desperate homeowner begs him to help; he stares in wide-eyed panic, then wrenches the pipe under the sink until water blasts him in the face and he lands soaked on the floor.
transcript: You as a plumber are my only chance. I'll be honest, I will say I'm just an electrician. I'll fix it!
